exposure: Gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) diagnosis by new vs. old criteria
outcome: Neonatal intensive care unit (NICU) admission rate
cohort: 641 singleton babies born to women who had oral glucose tolerance testing and pregnancy care at a single tertiary center between 2011 and 2015
finding: Neonates born to women diagnosed with GDM using the new, lower fasting glucose criterion had a higher rate of LGA but similar rates of other outcomes compared to those without GDM, while neonates of mothers previously diagnosed with GDM by older criteria had higher rates of SGA.
birth_weight: Birth weight was recorded and used to calculate birth weight percentile.
